name: EasyGrade v1.0.3
notes:
## EasyGrade v1.0.3

### New Features
- Clean reads start reviewed; flagged pages count toward the Grading badge
- New tests start with default instructions that are selected on focus

### Bug Fixes
- Scroll a newly added question into view and focus its stem


---

### Downloads

| Platform | Download |
|----------|----------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `EasyGrade-1.0.3-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `EasyGrade-1.0.3-x64.dmg` |
| Windows (Installer) | `EasyGrade-Setup-1.0.3.exe` |
| Windows (Portable) | `EasyGrade-Portable-1.0.3.exe` |
| Linux (AppImage) | `EasyGrade-1.0.3-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux (Debian) | `EasyGrade-1.0.3-amd64.deb` |

### Installation

**macOS**: Download the DMG, open it, and drag EasyGrade to your Applications folder.

**Windows**: Download and run the installer, or run the portable EXE directly. If you see a SmartScreen warning, click "More info" then "Run anyway".

**Linux (AppImage)**: Download the AppImage, make it executable (`chmod +x`), and run with: `./EasyGrade-*.AppImage --no-sandbox`

**Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)**: Install the .deb package: `sudo dpkg -i EasyGrade-*.deb`

name: EasyGrade v1.0.2
notes:
## EasyGrade v1.0.2

### New Features
- Remember the window size and position across launches, fitted to the current displays
- Results: Print sheets before grading and Import scans on the empty state; assign panel defaults to the batch's test; Sheets made column and print instruction; loud errors instead of silent catches
- Sections: skeleton on first load, land in the roster after create, delete hint when non-empty, paste from spreadsheet in the empty roster, duplicate student number check
- Copy a test to several sections with Finalize copies now; New Test from a section skips the dialog
- Editor: finalize validation before the click, title required on create, retry chip and pagehide save, key-change confirm, one radio group per question, keep pasted text on backdrop click
- One-click student history from roster rows, results names, and the review drawer header
- Tests page toolbar: section, title search, and status filters that persist while navigating
- Grading day flow: drawer navigation, bulk conflict resolution, batch done state, results filters
- Readability theme pass, toast actions with Undo, text size setting

### Bug Fixes
- Focus the placeholder title after the editor mounts; assign panel fetches its batch for the default test

### Refactoring
- Navigation history stack, rail highlight from the trail root, remember the last page across launches
- One PageHeader everywhere, results header overflow menu, flag chip cap, roster Import menu, editor hierarchy
